title: My Brother Bill
transcription:
My Brother Bill

My brother Bill's a fireman bold
cause he puts out fires.
He went to a fire last night I'm told,
cause he puts out fires.
There was a blast of dynamite
that blew poor Bill right out of sight,
But where he goin' he'll be all right
cause he puts out fires.
